title: BranchingPaths Story Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for narrative story data in BranchingPaths Godot 4 mobile game.

game_title.description: The title of the narrative game.

total_endings.description: Total number of possible endings achievable across all chapters.

chapters.description: Map of chapter keys (e.g. '1', '2') to Chapter definitions.

Chapter.description: A single chapter containing narrative checkpoints.

id.description: Unique short key identifier for the chapter.

summary.description: Short synopsis or logline of the chapter.
summary.example: You arrive at the old estate through fog and rain.

checkpoints.description: Map of checkpoint IDs to Checkpoint definitions within this chapter.

Checkpoint.description: A node in the narrative flow representing a scene, decision point, puzzle, or story ending.

id.description: Unique identifier for this checkpoint across the entire game.

chapter.description: Chapter number or chapter ID that owns this checkpoint.

scene.description: Resource path to the Godot .tscn file associated with this checkpoint.

speaker.description: Optional default speaker or POV character for the checkpoint.

dialogue.description: Sequential dialogue lines displayed during this checkpoint.

choices.description: Interactive choices presented to the player (primarily for type 'choice').

on_enter.description: Flag state modifications executed immediately when entering this checkpoint.

next.description: ID of the target checkpoint to advance to automatically when dialogue/scene completes.

end_type.description: Required when type is 'end'. Categorizes ending result ('good', 'bad', 'neutral', 'secret').

mission_id.description: Level id under assets/data/levels/ for checkpoints of type 'mission'.

DialogueEntry.description: A single line of spoken text or narration.

speaker.description: Name or ID of character speaking ('narrator', 'alice', 'player').

text.description: Spoken text line displayed on screen.
text.example: You came. I wasn't sure you would.

voice.description: Optional path to voice audio file (.wav/.ogg).

ChoiceEntry.description: An interactive selection option presented to the player.

id.description: Unique identifier for this choice option.

text.description: Button label text shown to the player.

requires.description: Condition map or flag state required for this choice to be visible/selectable. Supports boolean checks or operator-value objects.

effects.description: Flag state modifications executed when the player selects this choice.

next.description: ID of the checkpoint to transition to after picking this choice.

FlagOperation.description: Operation dict applying mutation to game flags ('set', 'add', 'sub', 'toggle', 'clear').

set.description: Sets flag key(s) to specified values (boolean, integer, string).

add.description: Increments integer flag key(s) by value.

sub.description: Decrements integer flag key(s) by value.

toggle.description: Flips boolean flag key(s) from true to false or false to true.

clear.description: Resets flag key(s) to default values.
